tim_output.campaign_summary: AvosLocker is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) variant operated by affiliates who have compromised organizations across multiple critical infrastructure sectors in the United States since at least May 2023, targeting Windows, Linux, and VMware ESXi environments. The affiliates employ legitimate remote administration tools (Splashtop Streamer, AnyDesk, Tactical RMM, and others) combined with open-source utilities (Cobalt Strike, Mimikatz, Rclone) to establish persistence, move laterally, exfiltrate data, and execute ransomware. The campaign uses exfiltration-based data extortion tactics with threats to leak or publish stolen data, making this a significant threat to critical infrastructure requiring immediate defensive action and incident reporting.
